summary_md: **Andrew Peltekci ([@apple_techie](https://x.com/apple_techie/status/2115988400557981807))** made **One-take VFX** during ComfyUI Build Night LA for the Open Source Higgsfield challenge: a clip shot on a phone gets an effect such as fire, a portal, a neon wireframe or an aurora, rendered by LTX 2.5 inside ComfyUI, with open weights throughout and an MIT license ([Kainotomic/one-take-vfx](https://github.com/Kainotomic/one-take-vfx), [demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mP7K5n_z92U&feature=youtu.be)).
